action_items: No code changes required — Sheet refactor confirmed working across the entire app on the 390x844 viewport. Both amount modals (earn + budget) sit right under the subtitle (~49px gap, no huge blank), amount + Save buttons are fully visible, and the web backdrop no longer anchors below the fold.

iOS-native keyboard-lift path (KeyboardAvoidingView behavior='padding' on iOS) cannot be exercised via Playwright web preview; recommend a quick manual TestFlight smoke on real iPhone to confirm the whole sheet lifts above the keyboard when the amount field is focused.
critical_code_review_comments: appShared.tsx Sheet — position:'fixed' cast via 'as any' is fine for react-native-web but tsc/eslint will flag it; keeping the inline comment is enough for reviewers. Non-blocking.

Sheet ScrollView maxHeight:520 is a hard-coded pixel. Works today because modalSheet maxHeight is 90% (~760px) and content rarely exceeds 520. If future sheets add long content, consider tying to flex layout inside the KAV rather than a magic number.
